free_text_notes.physician_note: 60-year-old man with prior TIA, atrial fibrillation, admitted 3/24 with left thalamic infarct with sensory deficits. Deficits stable for 48 hours; passed bedside swallow. Needs stroke clinic follow-up within 14 days of discharge. A mild rash appeared briefly at the IV insertion site on day 2. It was assessed as a minor irritation, treated with a topical cream, and has fully resolved.
